verdict.rationale: Twenty's source is hosted publicly on GitHub (twentyhq/twenty), and the install script is pulled directly from that repo's main branch. Community comments independently describe it as an open source CRM licensed under AGPLv3, which is an OSI-approved open license. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license in the docs or repo excerpts, and clarity on whether any parts of the codebase fall under a different (e.g., commercial) license.
